summary: FUUSIC Fun AI Phase D (MOBILE listen-only Interactive News) — frontend-only mobile testing passed end-to-end on the Expo web preview with the demo user. Verified News tab CTA navigation, 6-chip mode scroller, mode switching, Deep Dive topic input + Go, program playback area (segment, source, play, next), Follow This Story toggle + Following section with remove/open, Talk to Fun AI voice explainer modal (open/close), and pull-to-refresh / full reload resilience. The native live voice module is correctly NOT bundled — pressing fai-talk-btn only shows the explainer sheet (expected). All targeted testIDs render and behave as specified.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' is logged repeatedly across the app bundle (not specific to fun-ai-news, but surfaced during this test). Non-blocking cosmetic warning — consider migrating StyleSheet shadow* usages to boxShadow across shared components.

Metro reports a require cycle on every bundle. Not related to fun-ai-news but visible in logs — should be refactored to avoid uninitialized values. Reference: app/(tabs)/social.tsx <-> src/social/wall.tsx

action_items: (Optional, not blocking Phase D) migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in shared mobile components to clear console warnings.
(Optional, not blocking Phase D) break the require cycle between app/(tabs)/social.tsx and src/social/wall.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: fun-ai-news.tsx: solid. expo-audio is lazily require()'d in a try/catch (line 21-22) so the preview won't crash if the native module isn't present — good defensive pattern for native-only features.
The screen correctly scopes the voice feature to an explainer modal in preview (fai-voice-sheet) and does NOT import grokVoiceNative.ts into the bundle — matches the stated native-build-only design.

Follow-chip 'open' uses the nested TouchableOpacity (not the whole chip); works but makes the tappable area smaller than ideal. Consider enlarging the hit area or putting the remove button in a trailing control with its own hitSlop — currently requires precise tap on the text.
seed_data_creation: None. Used live /api/fun-ai/* data (Morning Briefing returned 8 segments, Deep Dive 'Dubai metro' returned a program, follows persisted and were removed cleanly).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Interactive News screen at /fun-ai-news is fully functional in preview. All testIDs from the review request are present and behave as specified: fai-title, fai-modes (fai-mode-morning_briefing/news_in_2/continuous/deep_dive/local/global), fai-deepdive-topic + fai-deepdive-go, fai-segment, fai-source, fai-play, fai-next, fai-follow-toggle, fai-following, fai-follow-<id>, fai-follow-remove-<id>, fai-talk-btn, fai-voice-sheet, fai-voice-close. news-interactive-cta on the News tab navigates to /fun-ai-news as expected. Pull-to-refresh / hard reload do not crash and re-hydrate the program. Deep Dive input is auto-prefilled when a follow chip is tapped. Voice sheet opens on fai-talk-btn and closes on fai-voice-close — live mic voice correctly NOT attempted in preview.
